# P03 completed implementation checkpoint

The approved plan and issue-free review in
runs/20261002T221346-d54a6552/P03 were verified against the actual files and prior
structured changes record. The prior timed-out report has been replaced by fresh
execution evidence; both required deliverables are complete for result review.

Skeptical audit: retain borrowing.acc, independently authored typed declarations,
corresponding authored IR fields and exact arithmetic as comparators. Acceptance
requires frontend equivalence, input sensitivity, semantic rejection, complete
catalog execution and unchanged protected inputs jointly. Schema and arithmetic
checks alone do not establish accounting or forecasting validity. Existing
Core0.1 scope, exact rationals and dependencies are unchanged; no scientific,
stochastic or performance comparison was run.

The checker now uses durable historical and supervisor execution inventories,
with explicit paths and hashes. It reports eight differences predating this
execution separately and fails on missing or malformed evidence, omitted/deleted
protected files, new mutations, or inventory changes during checking. Sixteen
checker-integrity obligations cover these cases and missing, duplicate, failed
or uncatalogued observations. Seven paired cases now retain both actual IRs,
independently authored typed inputs, both semantic/binding projections, source
maps and raw input hashes. The result report is generated from actual observations.

Final executed commands and results:

- python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p03.py' -v:
  11 methods passed in 2.163 seconds; no failures, errors or skips.
- python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p03.py --output-dir data/accounting-master/deliverables/P03:

  seven independent source/typed pairs. No missing, extra, duplicate or failed
